weaknesses.title: Unknown SYS form: err_line=0 and last_err is entire catalog dump
weaknesses.detail: Typo like SYS LINES_N or SYS NOTAFORM fails with last_err equal to the long SYS: READ|WRITE|… help string and err_line=0. Agents cannot locate the bad line; plate is nearly useless for recovery. Caught mid-program as ok=false under -s.
weaknesses.repro: SYS NOTAFORM or SYS LINES_N → err_line=0 last_err starts with 'SYS: READ|WRITE|…'

weaknesses.title: PUSH does not update bag var in place — must LET bag = LAST each time
weaknesses.detail: SYS PUSH bag line returns new bag in LAST/PUSH_N but does not write back to bag. Forgetting LET bag = LAST silently drops prior pushes. Real multi-probe loops are error-prone without in-place bag mutate.
weaknesses.repro: SYS PUSH bag a; SYS PUSH bag b without LET bag=LAST between → second push uses original empty/old bag.

weaknesses.title: SYS TRIM still missing from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: Carry-over: TRIM works in kv loader but catalog still empty. Multi-probe did not need TRIM but agents still cannot discover it.

weaknesses.title: LAST_N still ephemeral — every probe needs LINES to re-count bag
weaknesses.detail: LINES exists and works, but agents must remember to re-count after EXIST/EQS/TOUCH. No sticky bag.length field updated by PUSH alone beyond PUSH_N on LAST only.
weaknesses.repro: After SYS EXIST, LAST_N is 0|1 not bag size; SYS LINES bag restores count.

weaknesses.title: Peer probe still host-env gated (CUBALC_P2P_SOFT)
weaknesses.detail: Without SOFT, program skips dial as SOFT line rather than hard-fail — good — but cannot set soft policy in-language.
weaknesses.repro: CUBALC_P2P_PEER set, SOFT unset → SOFT dial_skipped_no_soft

workarounds: Never invent SYS aliases; check forms/search; treat catalog-dump last_err as typo
Always LET bag = LAST immediately after every SYS PUSH
SYS LINES bag after any LAST_N-clobbering op before using count
CLEAR_ERR after INCLUDE OR and soft dial under -s
language_gaps: err_line + err_src for unknown SYS / parse failures
In-place PUSH bag (mutate var) or PUSH! form
PUSH_N sticky on bag var metadata
